summary: No confirmed verifier defect. Every graded rule in manual HC-4 (the 85/3 reference duration, the inclusive 80.0 threshold, sampled time from readings >=40.0 with 0.0 excluded, projection to the worker's own shift for partial surveys, the inclusive 3/4 boundary, whole-shift-or-longer keeping measured dose, the TWA formula, half-up rounding, the 82/85 status bands on the reported TWA, the inclusive 140.0 impulse, the exclusive 115.0 ceiling, group dose as the mean of shift doses, and group rows carrying no flags) has a sealed fixture whose full expected report changes when that rule is reverted to the shipped behaviour or to a plausible wrong variant. The three figures the manual leaves to today's code (below-3/4 projection, zero sampled time, counted level above the ceiling) are pinned by value and by shipped-package differentials. Tolerances match the instruction's pass/fail band, and the comparator accepts contract-valid alternatives (ints, extra worker keys, any serialization).
checks_performed: Read the judge guide, the examples, the instruction, README, manual HC-4, every shipped source module (environment and tests/shipped copies; the manifest hashes are identical and both copies were read), the driver, both Dockerfiles, test.sh and test_outputs.py in full.

Read every expected family. limits_workers.jsonl and limits_logs.jsonl are single long lines. Read truncated them, so I covered the rest with bounded Grep extractions: all 300 input workers, all 300 worker report rows (even and odd ids L160-L299 extracted separately), all 40 group rows, all 1,504 log pairs of limits_logs, all 500 peaks (only the final 170.0 reaches 140) and its complete report.

Traced these expected values by hand against the manual: paused_runs A1/A2 (sampled 370 of 480 is partial, x480/370 gives 281.19), below_three_quarters X1/X2/X3/Y1-Y6/V1/V2 (today's step with sampled time as the manual defines it), partial_surveys B2 (projection to a 360 shift rather than 480 gives 755.95), whole_shift A1 (sampled 420 on a 360 shift keeps 175), three_quarters A1/B2 and below_three_quarters Y5 (458 vs 457 on a 610 shift, 3/4 = 457.5), sampled_time B2 (a 40.0 reading counts, giving 6.67 instead of 3200), above_ceiling Y1 (counted at 115, 5178.55), limits_logs L-2880/L-PEAKS.

Mutation reasoning (a static trace; nothing was executed). Each of these plausible wrong implementations changes at least one exactly compared figure. Shipped 90/5 exchange (reference_duration). Threshold >80 (threshold A1 vs A2). Sampled time from counted readings only (sampled_time A1, below_three_quarters V1: 200 vs 100). Counting 0.0 runs in sampled time (paused_runs A1). Projecting to 480 (partial_surveys B2). Projecting whenever sampled<shift (below_three_quarters X1: 476 vs 317). Scaling down when sampled>shift (whole_shift A1). Floor rounding (rounding R0 84.0 vs 84.1, status T0). Status on the unrounded TWA (status T1/T0). >=85 as over (status S3). Impulse >140 (impulse A2). Ceiling >=115 (ceiling_level). Removing the 115 clamp (above_ceiling Y1 and the differential). Group mean of TWAs (groups G1: 87.3 vs 90.8). Excluding quiet members from the group mean (quiet_members G1). Group status inheriting member flags (status H9, generated MOXEK302).

Checked the tolerance band. Expected doses carry 12 significant digits, so the storage error is at most 5e-12 relative. The 5e-11 grading bound therefore accepts any dose within 1e-11 and rejects any dose more than 1e-10 off, as instruction.md promises. The absolute branch applies below 1.

Checked whether any fixture could land on an exact half-tenth TWA. Every dose/100 lies in Q(2^(1/30)), while a TWA on x.x5 needs 2^(m/60) with m odd, which is not in that field. The half-up tie-break is therefore unreachable in the domain, and round(), floor(x*10+0.5) and Decimal half-up all agree on every fixture.

Checked the comparator for false rejections. The TWA accepts int or float. Extra worker and top-level keys are ignored. JSON is parsed, not compared as text. Only group rows reject ceiling/impulse keys, which manual 6.1 and the README group schema support. The driver runs under -I -S with only the stdlib needed.

Checked the relabel transform on generated. Splitting runs, fresh ids, a shuffled worker order and a new name leave every manual-defined figure unchanged. The expected report is permuted to match. within_limits is reasserted on the relabelled survey.
Checked that within_limits and trap_inputs are asserted on every sealed survey at load time, which keeps inputs the manual leaves open out of families that do not declare them.

Checked the reward channel. The reward is 1 only if pytest exits 0 and the driver on the documented path still matches the shipped bytes. test_submitted_driver_unchanged compares the delivered bytes recorded before any candidate code runs.

coverage_sweep.category: Map each required behavior to an assertion that fails if missing or reversed
coverage_sweep.reason: One test per manual rule (3.1, 2.3, 2.4, 2.2, 3.3 x2, 2.5, 4.1, 1.2, 5.3, 5.1, 5.2, 6.1 x2, ordering, section 1 limits, the three kept figures). Each compares the complete report, and I traced a changed figure for each reversal.

coverage_sweep.category: Check the full core result (values, membership, uniqueness, required outputs)
coverage_sweep.reason: compare() checks the survey name, row counts and order of both lists, every README key per row, the exact string/bool/status/twa values and the dose within tolerance.

coverage_sweep.category: Each named domain rule has an isolating case whose outcome changes when the rule is wrong
coverage_sweep.reason: The isolating fixtures are threshold 79.9/80.0/80.1, sampled_time 40.0, paused 0.0 runs, the three_quarters 458/457 pair on a 610 shift, the ceiling 115.0/115.1 pair, impulse 139.9/140.0, status 81.9/82.0/85.0/85.1 plus rounding-sensitive T0-T3, group mean vs TWA mean, and a quiet member at dose 0.
I traced 16 wrong variants, including the shipped behaviour of each defect named in the instruction. Each fails a named family. A fixed-answer lookup fails the runtime relabel of generated.

coverage_sweep.category: Contract-valid alternatives (formatting, ordering, implementation choices) are accepted
coverage_sweep.reason: Parsed JSON with extra keys ignored, int or float numbers, any rounding implementation (exact halves are unreachable), a dose tolerance matching the instruction, and fp summation-order differences far inside 5e-11. Group rows reject only the flag keys manual 6.1 excludes.

coverage_sweep.category: Documented restrictions and lifecycle behavior enforced (driver unchanged, keep today's figures where the manual is silent)
coverage_sweep.reason: Driver bytes are recorded before any candidate code runs and compared, then compared again in test.sh. The kept figures are pinned by sealed values plus shipped-package differentials across shift changes and above-ceiling/115.0 pairs.

coverage_sweep.category: Proxy behavior, Oracle-specific representation, stale binaries, self-controlled comparisons, unreachable cases
coverage_sweep.reason: Expectations are sealed and digest-pinned, not produced by the candidate. The differential uses a verifier-owned shipped copy. Candidate code is Python source run fresh from /app/src. I found no unreachable graded case: all sealed surveys pass within_limits, and trap inputs are confined to declared families.
log2(D/100) is negative, zero and positive across fixtures (TWA 53.3, 85.0, 115.0). Dose 0 maps to a null TWA, and group dose 0 to a null TWA and status below.
The reduction is a stateless per-survey computation. Run order within a log does not affect any manual figure, and the relabel run-splitting exercises that.

coverage_sweep.category: Representation vs semantic content (encoding, key order, native type)
coverage_sweep.reason: Parsed JSON comparison. Type checks only where the README fixes the type (strings, booleans, number or null). No byte-level or key-order promise is imposed.

interaction_sweep.case_or_path: quiet_members HC4-0027: mean(317.48, 0) = 158.74 gives 87.0 over. HC4-0028 G2 has all members at zero, giving a null TWA and below.

interaction_sweep.case_or_path: measured_nothing A3: empty log with a 141.0 peak gives dose 0, TWA null, status over, impulse true.

Differential pairs vary only the shift while staying below 3/4 (360/600, 1440/1000, 90/120, 720/1400). The candidate's dose must not move. The family pins 480-projection values and measured dose once sampled >= 480.
